invaar.reason: Well painted, but every seed is a sleeveless bronze muscle cuirass with a skirt of leather strips: at 1x it reads as dark leather, next to invhla, and a player who knows the original (a heavily decorated plate armour with articulated arms) will not see Ancient Armor / Ornate Plate / Sacred Armor in it.

fix.desc: An ancient ornate heavy armour from a forgotten age: a heavy cuirass of dark old blackened steel with articulated arm plates of overlapping lames down to the elbows, broad layered shoulder plates and a short skirt of overlapping lames split at the front, every plate richly decorated: each plate edge framed by a raised band of tarnished gilt bronze, a broad embossed sunburst of straight rays spreading across the chest, a row of small embossed rosettes along every lame, the gilding worn away on the high points. Laid flat, front view, empty, no person.
fix.note: the object is the ornate heavy plate with arms; the ornament (gilt edge bands, sunburst, rosettes) is ours, not the original's scrollwork; gilt, so no material line
fix.seeds: a new run with style.mjs SEEDS (101-404): the changed words make new jobs

invfld.reason: The words gave the thigh plates no material, and the material line's "brown leather" made all four seeds hang two brown leather flaps from the waist: at 1x and 2x the steel top over brown flaps reads as a cuirass with trousers, not a heavy field plate harness, and it is the hardest of the steel cuirasses (invbrs, invplt, invgth) to tell apart.

fix.desc: A heavy field plate harness for the body, plain and massive: a broad grey steel breastplate with a second plate overlapping its lower half and rising to a point at the middle, a high steel collar closing round the neck, big rounded shoulder plates that rise like domes above the shoulders, and two broad square grey steel thigh plates, each of three overlapping riveted steel lames, hanging from the steel waist plate on short straps with a gap between them; steel everywhere, the only leather a few small straps; no sleeves, no mail, no leather skirt. Laid flat, front view, empty, no person.

invful.reason: All four seeds paint a whole headless man of armour: legs down to sabatons or boots and dark hands at the wrists, standing like a figure. That breaks the no-hands rule, reads as a person at 1x, and is not the object of the original, a cuirass with arms and thigh plates that stops at the knees; nothing in the prompt holds the knee line, and the material line adds a brown leather skirt.

fix.desc: A full plate armour for the body and arms, hollow and empty: a rounded grey steel breastplate, large overlapping shoulder plates, complete arm plates with round elbow cops hanging straight down beside the body and ending at the wrists in open round steel rims with nothing in them, a waist of several overlapping steel lames and two long jointed steel thigh plates that end at the knees in round knee cops; the armour stops at the knees: no lower legs, no feet, no hands, no gauntlets, no helmet, no leather skirt. Laid flat, front view, empty, no person.
fix.guideSpec: new: a suit family in box/guides.py, on the 832x1248 canvas, a generic shape of our own: a cuirass from a neck opening at y~90 to the waist at y~650 with two rounded shoulder caps; each arm a tube hanging straight down beside the body from its cap to an open wrist rim at y~820, a round elbow cop at y~480; three waist lames; two thigh tubes with a gap between them ending in round knee cops at y~1170; nothing below the knee cops and the wrist rims empty (lighter grey inside)

invltp.reason: All four seeds make a brown leather dress, short leather sleeves and a knee-length leather skirt, with a small steel breastplate on it: at 1x brown leather dominates and it reads as a tunic or robe, not a light plate armour (the original's object is a light steel cuirass with shoulder and hip plates); s101 and s404 also split the breastplate hard into a lit and a black half.

fix.desc: A light plate armour: a slim grey steel breastplate with a short fauld of two steel lames and two small rounded steel tassets over the hips, small round steel discs at the shoulders, all thinner and plainer than a knight's plate, worn over a padded brown leather jack that shows only as short cap sleeves at the shoulders and a narrow hem just below the tassets; the plates held on by buckled leather straps at the sides; grey steel covering most of it, no long skirt. Laid flat, front view, empty, no person.

invrng.reason: All four seeds paint what the words asked, a sleeveless knee-length brown leather coat with iron rings sewn on (s101's rings came out as domed studs), and it reads as a studded brown leather coat: a player who knows the original (a grey long-sleeved ring shirt) will not recognise ring mail, and at 34 px it is confused with invstu and invlea.

fix.desc: A ring mail shirt: a long-sleeved coat to the upper thighs covered completely in large flat iron rings, each as wide as a thumb, sewn on in close overlapping horizontal rows so that grey iron covers the whole coat and the dark leather backing only shows as a dot inside each ring, the rings much larger and coarser than fine chain mail so that every ring can be seen; the sleeves reach the wrists and end in a band of leather, the neck a low round opening bound in leather, the hem split at the front; iron grey dominating, no plates. Laid flat, front view, empty, no person.
fix.note: told apart from invchn (fine mesh, elbow sleeves, hip length) by its big visible rings, long sleeves and longer split hem

invspl.reason: The model set four to six wide iron strips far apart on a knee-length brown leather coat, so leather dominates and at 1x it reads as a striped sleeveless leather dress, not a splinted iron armour (the original's object is a sleeveless grey vest of iron splints); the material line's "brown leather" pushes it further.

fix.desc: A splint armour cuirass, sleeveless, reaching only to the hips: fourteen or more narrow vertical iron splints set edge to edge across the chest and belly, so close that only thin dark lines of leather show between them, each splint held by a round rivet at its top and its bottom end, the splints at the waist a little shorter so that the hem steps; small shoulder guards of three short horizontal splints each, the neck and armholes bound in dark leather; grey iron covering almost all of it. Laid flat, front view, empty, no person.
fix.note: our splints stand vertical and edge to edge; the original's rows of small horizontal splints are not ours

invvbt.reason: The heavy-boots guide's thick stacked sole with hobnails came out on all four seeds as a deep treaded lug sole with a raised heel: modern work or biker boots that break the period look at 2x; and the tall straight shaft gives almost the same silhouette as invlbt at 1x (the horn toggles do not read at 34 px).

fix.desc: A pair of heavy boots, short and massive: thick stiff dark brown leather reaching only to mid-calf, broader and bulkier than soft boots, a deep band of shaggy dark fur round the top of each boot, one wide leather strap with a square iron buckle across the instep, a broad rounded toe with an extra stitched leather cap; a thin flat leather sole with no tread, no lugs and no heel at all. Standing side by side, both toes pointing right. Side view.
fix.guideSpec: corrected: top ~300 instead of 40 (mid-calf), sole 8 (thin and flat: drop the stacked hobnail sole), toggles off, toe_cap on, and two new boots() options: fur (a ragged-edged band ~90 px tall over the top of the shaft) and strap (one buckled band across the instep)
